label: CMake: Clean (NDS Debug)
command: if [ -d out/build/nds-debug-sdcard ]; then cmake --build out/build/nds-debug-sdcard --target clean; else echo 'Skipping NDS Debug clean: build directory does not exist'; fi

label: CMake: Clean (NDS Release)
command: if [ -d out/build/nds-release ]; then cmake --build out/build/nds-release --target clean; else echo 'Skipping NDS Release clean: build directory does not exist'; fi

label: CMake: Clean (Host Debug)
command: if [ -d out/build/host-debug ]; then cmake --build out/build/host-debug --target clean; else echo 'Skipping Host Debug clean: build directory does not exist'; fi

label: CMake: Clean (All)
command: cmake -DP3D_SOURCE_DIR="$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT" -P cmake/CleanAssets.cmake; if [ -d out/build/host-debug ]; then cmake --build out/build/host-debug --target clean; fi; if [ -d out/build/nds-debug-sdcard ]; then cmake --build out/build/nds-debug-sdcard --target clean; fi; if [ -d out/build/nds-release ]; then cmake --build out/build/nds-release --target clean; fi
